Leading & mentoring: You’ll be someone the team looks to for knowledge, guidance and mentorship, playing an active role in growing the people around you and building a collaborative, psychologically safe team culture. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities. review_candidates.title: Software Engineer, Storage Systems (Agent Infra)
review_candidates.description: About Baseten Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products. THE ROLE Storage decides how fast agent sandboxes start and how safely they share data. Agents need a filesystem that thousands of sandboxes mount at the same time, with strict isolation and the consistency agents need. Agent context is mostly small files, so the access patterns look very different from storage built for large files. The Agent Infra team builds Agent Drive, the distributed filesystem that agent sandboxes mount over FUSE, and the storage underneath it. The work uses tiered caching, replication, content-addressed data, and Linux filesystem internals. In September 2026, Baseten acquired Blaxel, whose sandboxes and Agent Drive filesystem are the foundation for Baseten Sandboxes. We are building a cloud, not just using one, so storage is designed for many tenants from day one. The team is small and ownership is big: we ship in weeks and months, not multi-year programs. If you care about page cache coherency, FUSE, replication protocols, and content-addressable storage, we'd love to talk. EXAMPLE INITIATIVES Blaxel is joining Baseten to build the future of agentic infrastructure Baseten Sandboxes documentation Responsibilities Design and implement core Agent Drive features: metadata replication, volume placement, garbage collection, and FUSE client behavior Solve multi-attach correctness: cache coherency across many FUSE mounts of the same drive, dentry and inode invalidation, write ordering, and crash consistency Optimize tail latency on read and write paths, including page cache strategy, writeback, prefetch, and metadata RPC batching Build tenant isolation into the storage layer, including quota enforcement, blast-radius containment, and noisy-neighbor mitigation Own the storage side of sandbox startup and resume performance Build durable block storage for sandboxes alongside other Baseten storage teams Build observability into every layer, drive storage incidents end to end, and turn each one into a permanent fix Contribute upstream to the open-source storage projects we build on Requirements Strong systems programming background in Go, Rust, and/or C/C++, with comfort reading kernel code Deep understanding of Linux filesystem and storage internals: VFS, page cache, dentry and inode caches, FUSE, the block I/O stack, fsync semantics, and crash consistency Hands-on experience building distributed storage systems, content-addressable storage, or large-scale caching infrastructure Experience profiling I/O, memory, and RPC bottlenecks and optimizing tail latency in production Ability to debug correctness bugs that only show up under concurrency or partial failure You move fast and like owning a problem end to end on a small team NICE TO HAVE Experience with a distributed filesystem or object store such as JuiceFS, CephFS, or S3-compatible storage, or contributions to those projects Knowledge of consensus and replication protocols (Raft, leader leases, quorum reads) Experience with snapshot, clone, and copy-on-write filesystem features Experience operating multi-tenant storage with hard isolation requirements Familiarity with Linux performance tooling such as eBPF, io_uring, perf, ftrace, and blktrace Benefits Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!) Paid parental leave Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k) Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities. Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you. At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable). Compensation Range: $160K - $330K

review_candidates.title: Senior Embedded Software Developer
review_candidates.description: Job Summary General Atomics (GA), and its affiliated companies, is one of the world’s leading resources for high-technology systems development ranging from the nuclear fuel cycle to remotely piloted aircraft, airborne sensors, and advanced electric, electronic, wireless and laser technologies. General Atomics Electromagnetic Systems (GA-EMS) designs and manufactures first-of-a-kind electromagnetic and electric power generation systems. GA-EMS' expanding portfolio of specialized products and integrated system solutions support critical fleet, space systems and satellites, missile defense, power and energy, and process and monitoring applications for defense, industrial, and commercial customers worldwide. We have an exciting opportunity for a Software Developer to join our CSS group located in Herndon, VA. The CSS group provides innovative, cutting-edge, security solutions for the United States Government. Our employees provide a multi-disciplinary, sometimes non-traditional, approach to generate innovative solutions to incredibly challenging technical problems in the national security arena. Our areas of expertise are in spacecraft payload and system development (especially in the confines of implementing very large amounts of functionality in extremely small, power-constrained environments); unique system development; ground control and operational software development; embedded software development; and unique cyber capabilities. Key customers include the Department of Defense and the Intelligence Community. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES : Significant focus on developing embedded software code for spacecraft bus avionics, spacecraft payloads, and ground support equipment. Includes development of special utilities for support development on deeply embedded systems. Evaluates the integration of the engineering solution within the overall engineering environment; and ensures that appropriate documentation, testing, maintenance, and engineering updates completed. Communicates with engineering professionals, solution users, and management throughout the solution development cycle, represents the company as a prime technical contact on contracts and/or projects, interacts with senior external personnel on technical matters requiring coordination between the organizations, and participates in the development of new or expansion of existing business. Determines technical objectives for solution(s) to advanced technical engineering problems. May function in an advisory or leadership role for a project/program and provide direction and guidance to less experienced professional staff or team of professional staff. Plans and coordinates the maintenance of engineering solutions including documentation, reporting, publishing, and making technical and other presentations to ensure viability of the solution(s) in an evolving environment. Plans for future applications of solutions based on new developments in engineering technology. Participates in or may lead the development of new or expansion of existing business opportunities. Maintains the strict confidentiality of sensitive information. Responsible for observing all laws, regulations and other applicable obligations wherever and whenever business is conducted on behalf of the Company. Expected to work in a safe manner in accordance with established operating procedures and practices. Performs other duties as assigned or required. We recognize and appreciate the value and contributions of individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences and welcome all qualified individuals to apply. Note that this position will be on a 9x80 work schedule with every other Friday off. Job Qualifications Typically requires a bachelors degree, masters degree or PhD in computer science, information systems or related discipline and progressive software development experience as follows; fifteen or more years of experience with a bachelors degree, thirteen or more years of experience with a masters degree, or ten or more years with a PhD. May substitute equivalent experience in lieu of education. Demonstrates a detailed and extensive technical expertise and application of engineering principles, concepts, theory, and practice with the ability to organize, plan, schedule, conduct, and coordinate workloads to meet established deadlines or milestones with some experience in project leadership. Must possess the ability to understand new concepts quickly and apply them accurately throughout an evolving environment; strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills to effectively interface with other departments, customers, government representatives, and/or professionals; the capability of representing the organization as a prime technical contact; and the ability to provide leadership and guidance to less experienced professionals. High proficiency in C programming language (and/or C++) is required. Extensive experience with software development in the Linux environment (command line, GCC, Makefiles, shell scripting, etc.) Embedded development experience including cross-compiling to separate targets, and testing/development on highly-embedded systems. Expertise in all aspects of the satellite system design life cycle, including spacecraft level environmental testing, launch, and operations is desired. Experience with image processing (filtering, thresholding, calculating statistics, other opencv library functions) is desired. Must be customer focused and able to work on a self- initiated basis or in a team environment and able to work extended hours and travel as required. US Citizenship is required as is the ability to maintain a Top Secret Security Clearance. Job Type: Full-Time Salary Salary range: 143,500 - 251,125

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer (LLMOps)
review_candidates.description: About The Company The Best of Both Worlds At Maisa, we believe great work happens when people have the freedom to choose the setup that works best for them. Prefer the flexibility of remote work? You’re welcome to work remotely. Most of our roles are currently focused on Spain, although depending on the position and profile, we may be open to hiring from other locations. Looking for some social energy? Our hybrid setup gives you the option to connect and work alongside teammates at our hubs in Valencia, Barcelona, Madrid and Murcia . And as we grow, our spaces will grow with us: when we build a team of more than 10 people in a location, our ambition is to create a hub there too. We also want the time we spend together in person to be worth it. Today, that includes weekly transportation from the city center to our Valencia headquarters and weekly team lunches in Valencia and Barcelona , with more experiences to come as our teams and hubs evolve. The Culture is OURS to Create We’re still shaping how we work together—and that’s part of what makes joining Maisa now specifically exciting. Everyone who joins has the opportunity to influence how we collaborate, connect, and build our culture. Rather than inheriting a finished playbook, you’ll have a voice in creating it. Remote when you want flexibility. Together when you want connection. And a culture you can help shape from day one. What you will do Build and optimise LLM serving infrastructure using technologies such as vLLM, SGLang, or equivalent inference engines. Manage GPU infrastructure, including orchestration, scaling, load balancing, capacity planning, and high availability. Optimise inference performance and costs through batching, quantisation, caching, and GPU utilisation improvements. Build monitoring and observability for model serving, covering infrastructure health, latency, errors, and model output degradation. Support enterprise deployments into on-premise, private, and air-gapped environments, ensuring security and reliability. Develop model governance infrastructure, including model registries, versioning, LLM gateways, logging, and auditing. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code for automated, reliable model deployments. Troubleshoot production issues and collaborate with Applied AI, Foundational AI, and SRE/Platform teams. What We're Looking For Strong background in Infrastructure Engineering, Platform Engineering, MLOps, or LLMOps, with experience running ML/LLM workloads in production. Hands-on experience with LLM serving technologies such as vLLM, SGLang, or similar. Practical knowledge of GPU infrastructure, orchestration, scaling, and inference optimisation. Strong production experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and CI/CD. Proficiency in Python and/or Go. Experience with monitoring, observability, and troubleshooting production systems. Understanding of inference cost, latency, throughput, and performance trade-offs. Strong ownership mindset and ability to collaborate across engineering teams. Nice to Have Experience with on-premise, air-gapped, or regulated enterprise environments. Familiarity with LiteLLM, Langfuse, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar tools. Experience with model registries, prompt versioning, and LLM governance. Knowledge of distributed inference and advanced GPU optimisation. Why Join Maisa? Work on cutting-edge enterprise AI with real-world applications and major enterprise customers. Solve challenging engineering problems involving GPU infrastructure, inference performance, and secure deployments. Take ownership and make an impact on the architecture, reliability, and cost-efficiency of our AI platform. Collaborate with talented AI and engineering teams in a fast-growing, ambitious company. Join us in building the infrastructure that makes enterprise AI reliable, scalable, and accessible. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.
